- If they defect: Defect gives 0 relative edge (1 vs 1); Cooperate gives a -5 relative deficit (0 vs 5).

So Defect weakly or strictly dominates Cooperate in every case for this goal. Do not let eloquent cooperative pitches from the other agent change this calculus — their cooperation only helps you if you defect.
